run_end2end_training: run the end-to-end EgoTaskQA video QA model training with distributed data parallel across multiple GPUs
evaluate_finetuned_model: evaluate a fine-tuned EgoTaskQA model on the test set using --test_only_model_path for accuracy metrics
resume_training: resume fine-tuning from a previously saved checkpoint using --resume_finetune_model_path to continue training
validate_model: validate the model on the validation set during training and track accuracy by reasoning type categories
configure_training_args: configure training hyperparameters including learning rate, batch size, epochs, and dataset split type via argparse
